## Description

Train a policy-gradient agent to map market state to portfolio actions while optimizing a reward objective.

## Where it may fit

Research environments with repeatable simulation, realistic costs and enough varied data to train and validate.

## Vehicles

Experimental stock/ETF portfolios, futures/crypto simulations; not tied to a specific fund type.

## Required data

Historical market states, account/position state, action space, reward function, transaction costs, constraints and train/validation/test splits.

## Caveats

Policy performance can collapse out of sample; reward hacking, survivorship bias and simulator mismatch are major risks.
